notes.subject: ⟨में⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew has no preposition on ביקר; locative supplied for Magahi

notes.subject: נדמו
notes.rationale: root דמה: 'be dumb/silent' vs 'perish/be destroyed' — KJV 'perish', YLT 'cut off'

notes.subject: נמשל/נדמו
notes.rationale: likened/silenced-perished share the ד-מ frame; the man likened (נמשל) to beasts ends silenced (נדמו)

notes.subject: the verse
notes.rationale: weighing of man's honour against the beasts — the psalm's ledger closes

translation: आदमी इज्जत ⟨में⟩, बाकि समझदारी नञ — ऊ जीव-जंतु जइसन गिनाहइ, जे चुपचाप बिन गेलन।
